import.title: Import Daily Sales
import.formatColumns: A column for the menu item (name or SKU), one for quantity sold, and one for the sale date.
import.formatOptional: A POS reference column is optional. Report footers and blank lines are ignored.
import.impactExplainer: What running this batch would take out of stock, resolved through each recipe including sub-recipes.
import.impactEmpty: Nothing would be deducted — no matched row has a recipe yet.
import.confirmDescription: This records the sales and deducts their ingredients from stock. It cannot be undone in bulk — individual sales can be voided afterwards.
import.impactIncomplete: Matched menu items with no recipe: {{itemCount}} — their ingredients are missing from this preview.
import.confirmShortfall: Ingredients that will go below zero: {{itemCount}}. The deductions are still recorded — the shortfall is real.
import.dateFormatLabel: Date format used in this file
import.dateFormatHint: Only affects dates written with slashes or dashes — 03/04/2026 is 3 April or 4 March depending on this. Dates already written as 2026-04-03 are read the same way whatever you pick.
